resources.string: Messages you schedule on the iPhone are sent by this phone. Turn on Pairline Bridge under Alarms & reminders so they go out at the minute you chose. Without it, Android may send them a few minutes late.
Allow usage access for the data meter
The iPhone asked how much mobile data this phone used. Turn on Pairline Bridge under Usage access. Only the total goes to the iPhone, never which apps used it.
Plays a sound on the iPhone for 30 seconds, even on silent
The iPhone isn’t connected right now.
Update Pairline on the iPhone to ring it from here.
On: Pairline Bridge screens incoming calls
Tap to make Pairline Bridge Android’s call-screening app. Without it, a blocked call rings here for a moment before it’s declined.
Calls from numbers that aren’t in your contacts ring neither phone. They go to voicemail and show as missed.
End a number with * to block every number that starts with it, for example +234*.
